content: LdCom: ISignalIPdu not part of any ISignalIPduGroup Only if the ISignalIPdu is not referenced by any ISignalIPduGroup in the role iSignalIPdu and the LdCom module is present, this ISignalIPdu shall be handled by LdCom.
